Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Abhishek Chettiar
Message:
Move web auth to HttpOnly cookies; token & CI improvements

Switch web sessions to HttpOnly cookie-based auth with CSRF double-submit protection: add app/core/cookies.py, set/clear cookies on login/refresh/logout, and prefer cookie token in middleware. Migrate frontend token handling to in-memory cache (purge legacy localStorage), add Electron secureStorage IPC (preload + ipc-handlers), and hydrate tokens via tokenService.initTokenService. Update api.js to include CSRF header echoing and improved refresh logic. CI workflow tightened (development/production branches, secret scan, antiword install, audits, frontend tests, use .nvmrc). Also: wrap untrusted docs for LLM calls and prompts, make toon/db/IO fixes (quote-aware ?→%s conversion, stricter LLM parse checks), safer filename handling, improved error logging, support route auth improvements, file-type/UI tweaks, and backfill script dry-run/execute mode. Removed stale infra template.

Author: AI-Team-Dev
Message:
CI, DB migrations, multitenancy and security fixes

Add CI Postgres service and matrix, run Alembic in CI and use locked requirements. Enforce PostgreSQL 15+ in baseline and add three migrations: case-insensitive email index, hrid sequence allocation, and organization FK ON DELETE RESTRICT. Improve app security and config: default body limits, CSP/HSTS headers, DATABASE_URL parsing, and safer connection-pool overflow handling. Introduce collision-safe next_hrid service, organization slug conflict handling, password-strength checks and rollback on platform provisioning. Harden optional auth, rate-limits, session pruning, SQL apply error handling, file upload sniffing/sanitization, and in-memory eviction. Add comprehensive live DB tests and helpers for multitenancy and lifecycle scenarios.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Abhishek Chettiar
Message:
Add Alembic baseline, CI, auth & infra updates

Introduce a squashed Alembic baseline (20260810_s001) and move schema/seed SQL under apps/backend/alembic/baseline. Replace legacy schema_pg flow with Alembic-only upgrades and update env/migration helpers. Add GitHub Actions CI (unit, frontend build, alembic upgrade, AI runtime tests). Harden auth: enforce JWT_SECRET rules, deterministic dev fallback, include jti in tokens, and add refresh-token lifecycle (register/rotate/revoke) + rate-limiting and OTP hashing. Add Redis-backed shared_store with memory fallback, structured request logging, liveness (/health) and readiness (/ready) checks, OAuth state storage, interview slot claim/release to avoid races, numerous API/org scoping fixes, frontend test/tooling (vitest/jsdom), CSP & UI tweaks, docs and production docker-compose + backup runbook. Update requirements and package files accordingly.
